policies.description: the V0.3 protocol demonstration (agent.Greedy): raises one radiologist's site reading allocation by 5 points whenever the oldest unread study is over a day old; not a strategy

the financially conservative baseline, version 2 (V0.6c): watches the public log's urgent and soon report breaches; raises a site reading allocation by 5 points only for a problem sustained over a week (urgent breaches on 3 of 7 days or soon breaches on 5), within the trailing 30 days' operating profit after the change's cost, a $50,000 cash floor and a 10-point cap; reviews each raise after 14 days in effect and steps it back, raising no more, if breaches did not fall by a quarter; steps back when money is lost or service has been clear for a week
